name: Koneko
source:
A friendly cat that [url=/c29351]Minakami[/url] took in. It likes to sleep on his lap and cannot fall asleep without hearing people talk. Though the cat cannot meow and has no name, it is still loved by Minakami.

[Spoiler]In reality, the cat is possessed by another Hashihime, and Minakami plans to kill it and take its power if anything ever happens to [url=/c29350]Tamamori[/url].[/spoiler]

[Based on the [url=/r131128]fullscreen description[/url]]
